request.style: English, warm male solo voice, acoustic guitar, piano, soft strings, cello, hopeful and gentle mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
She stood alone in the dust and sand
The crowd had gone, leaving her in hand
Jesus straightened up to see her face
In the quiet place where silence traces

[Pre-Chorus]
Where are those who threw stones in the air
Has no one found a reason to spare
She looked down low, trembling with fear
Knowing that the end was near

[Chorus]
I am the light of the world
Whoever follows me is not unfurled
Never walk in the darkness deep
But hold the light of life in your sleep

[Verse]
They said your own words are not true
You testify only of you alone
But I know where I came from and where I go
You do not know the way to know

[Pre-Chorus]
You judge by the standards of men
But I judge not, for I am not in
Your human measure is blind and small
Before the truth that stands tall

[Chorus]
I am the light of the world
Whoever follows me is not unfurled
Never walk in the darkness deep
But hold the light of life in your sleep

[Bridge]
Neither do I condemn you now
Go from this place, make the light your vow
Sin no more, turn from the old way
Walk in the day, let the shadows fade away

[Outro]
I am the light of the world
The light of life, the light of the world
